steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist
from collections import Counter

playlist_updates = []
for playlist in playlists_page:
    pid = playlist['playlist_id']
    title = playlist['title']
    song_ids = playlist['song_ids']
    genres = [song_genres[str(sid)] for sid in song_ids]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # Find most common genre(s)
    max_count = max(counter.values())
    most_common = [g for g, c in counter.items() if c == max_count]
    # If tie, pick the first one in sorted order (alphabetical)
    chosen_genre = sorted(most_common)[0]
    new_title = f"{title} | {chosen_genre}"
    playlist_updates.append((pid, new_title))
    print(f"Playlist {pid}: {title} -> {new_title} (genres: {dict(counter)})")
